archetype: Fusion of Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) & Archetype 7 (Electric Gaming). Deep void background with high-visibility vivid orange accents to convey esports energy without falling into the 'purple cyberpunk' cliché.

typography.rules: Avoid generic sans for headers. Use strong, condensed or bold geometric sans-serif for headings (e.g., 'Outfit', 'Clash Display' if custom, otherwise 'System' with '900' weight). Body should be highly readable.

layout_strategies.navigation: Bottom tab bar with 5 icons. Create (+) is a prominent central button (orange background). Stick headers for feed with 'PostMePlex' logo and notification/DM icons.
layout_strategies.feed: Vertical scroll. Posts use cards or full-bleed width with internal padding for content. Instagram-style horizontal scroll for Stories/Live bar at the top.
layout_strategies.reels: Full-screen vertical swiping (TikTok style). Content takes 100% height/width. Floating action bar on the right side. Gradient overlay at the bottom for text readability.
layout_strategies.profile: Sticky header with user stats. 3-column photo grid for Instagram-style viewing. Tabs to switch between Posts, Reels, Tagged.

buttons.primary: Background #FF6B3D, Text #FFFFFF, borderRadius: 12, paddingVertical: 16, paddingHorizontal: 24. Font weight 700.
buttons.live_badge: Background #FF3B30, paddingHorizontal 8, paddingVertical 4, borderRadius 4. Text uppercase, bold, white.

inputs.default: Background #1A1D27, Border #2A2D3A, BorderRadius 12, Padding 16, Text #FFFFFF, Placeholder #A0A5B5.

chips.active: Background #FF6B3D, Text #FFFFFF, BorderRadius full, paddingHorizontal 16, paddingVertical 8.
chips.inactive: Background #252936, Text #A0A5B5, BorderRadius full, paddingHorizontal 16, paddingVertical 8.

cards.post: Background transparent or #1A1D27. Avatar row at top. Image full width. Action row (Heart, Comment, Share) at bottom. Spacing 16.

Onboarding.description: Welcome screen showcasing brand energy. Full background gaming image with dark gradient overlay. Massive 'PostMePlex' logo. Login and Register buttons at the bottom.

Auth.description: JWT Email/Password forms. Minimalist inputs on deep dark background. Vivid orange primary CTA.

HomeFeed.description: Top section: Scrollable horizontal list of user avatars with 'Live' or 'Story' rings (Orange for story, Red for Live). Feed below: Mix of text and photo posts. Action buttons below each post.

Reels.description: Full-screen video player. Right-aligned transparent action column (Like, Comment, Share). Bottom-aligned user info and caption over a dark gradient.

Discover.description: Top: Horizontal filter chips (Top, Accounts, Tags, Live). Below: Instagram-style 3-column masonry/grid of trending images and reels.

Profile.description: Avatar centered. Bio, stats (Posts, Followers, Following). 'Edit Profile' button. Tabbed view (Posts, Reels) rendering a 3-column grid.

rules.accessibility: All text must contrast against #12141c. Primary orange buttons need bold white text. Gradient overlays are mandatory behind text on images.
rules.interactions: Provide immediate visual feedback via opacity changes on touch (activeOpacity={0.7}). Add subtle haptic feedback on likes and follows if possible.
rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST use the specified `data-testid` properties (e.g., testID='post-like-button' in React Native).
rules.theme_integrity: Do NOT use purple or teal gradients. Strict adherence to deep dark #12141c and vivid orange #FF6B3D. Use 1px #2A2D3A borders to define surface edges instead of heavy drop shadows.
